source_checks.finding: Page section 'Block pop-ups and redirects from a site' gives the steps for Chrome on a computer: open Chrome, click More, then Settings; click Privacy and security, then Site Settings; click Pop-ups and redirects; under 'Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects,' find the site; to the right of the site click More, then Block. If the site isn't listed, next to 'Not allowed to send pop-ups or use redirects,' click Add, enter the site's web address, then click Add. The domain pattern is [*.]example.com. The opening sentence 'By default, Google Chrome blocks pop-ups from automatically showing up on your screen.' is verified. Applies to Chrome on a computer, the user's platform.

required_actions.action: Open Chrome, click More, then Settings
Go to Privacy and security, then Site Settings, then Pop-ups and redirects
Find the site under Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects, click More next to it, then Block
If the site is not listed, click Add next to Not allowed to send pop-ups or use redirects, enter the web address, then click Add
Optional domain pattern [*.]example.com to cover all of a domain
